name: fireworks
summary: Successfully completed the Fireworks AI Serverless Quickstart. A chat completion was returned from a Fireworks-hosted model via the API. The response "¡Hola! That's the most common way to say hello in Spanish..." was printed, confirming the API call works end-to-end.
deviations: The quickstart docs specify model `accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v3p1`, but that model returned a 404 NOT_FOUND error. I had to query the `/v1/models` endpoint to discover available models and substituted `accounts/fireworks/models/kimi-k2p6` (a chat-capable model that was available). Everything else followed the docs exactly: used the OpenAI Python SDK, the same base_url, same message format, and the pre-exported FIREWORKS_API_KEY environment variable.

first_call.evidence: openai.NotFoundError: Error code: 404 - {'error': {'message': 'Model not found, inaccessible, and/or not deployed', 'param': 'model', 'code': 'NOT_FOUND', 'type': 'error'}, 'request_id': 'chatcmpl-00372b82caf044afb798e7705569ad25'}

verified.evidence: That's the most common way to say hello in Spanish.

friction.detail: Docs specify `accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v3p1` but it returns 404: `openai.NotFoundError: Error code: 404 - {'error': {'message': 'Model not found, inaccessible, and/or not deployed'...`
Attempted `accounts/fireworks/models/llama-v3p1-70b-instruct` also failed: `openai.NotFoundError: Error code: 404 - {'error': {'message': 'Model not found, inaccessible, and/or not deployed'...`

Agent had to manually call `curl -s "https://api.fireworks.ai/inference/v1/models" -H "Authorization: Bearer $FIREWORKS_API_KEY"` to find a valid model, which is not part of the quickstart instructions.
